# Header-detection fixtures

Copied unchanged from react-data-import (`packages/react-data-import/test/fixtures`, generated by its `generate.ts`, commit 24f90d5), so `detectHeader` is checked here on the same files. Only the files about the header are copied. If react-data-import regenerates them, copy them again.

`.gitattributes` turns off line-ending conversion, so the CSV bytes stay as generated.
